about: Synthetic cases for run_checks.py. Each case runs once per provider. A case with schema_from reuses the schema its schema case generated for the same provider; when that case failed, the dependent case is skipped. Values in expect are compared after normalising case, spaces, number formats and dates (see compare_value in run_checks.py).

cases.title: Flat invoice schema keeps date, number and enum types (Finnish task)
cases.requirements: Poimi laskusta nämä kentät. Käytä täsmälleen näitä kenttänimiä: invoice_number (laskun numero, teksti), invoice_date (laskun päivämäärä, päivämäärä muodossa VVVV-KK-PP), supplier (toimittajan nimi, teksti), total_amount (laskun loppusumma veroineen, desimaaliluku), currency (valuutta, yksi arvoista EUR, USD tai SEK).
cases.rubric: Five fields with exactly the requested names. invoice_date is a date in YYYY-MM-DD, total_amount a number, currency limited to EUR, USD and SEK. Descriptions say what each field holds; nothing is added or dropped.

cases.title: Invoice header with a nested list of line items
cases.requirements: Poimi laskun otsikkotiedot ja jokainen laskurivi. Otsikkotiedot: invoice_number (laskun numero, teksti) ja supplier (toimittajan nimi, teksti). Laskurivit listana nimeltä line_items; jokaisella rivillä description (rivin kuvaus, teksti), quantity (määrä, kokonaisluku), unit_price (yksikköhinta, desimaaliluku) ja line_total (rivin summa, desimaaliluku).
cases.rubric: A parent record with invoice_number and supplier, and a list called line_items whose items have description (text), quantity (integer), unit_price and line_total (numbers). The line items are not flattened into the parent.

cases.title: Text extraction from a Finnish invoice (Finnish date and decimal comma)
cases.rubric: One record. total_amount is the total including VAT (551,57), not the net 439,50 or the VAT 112,07. invoice_date is the invoice date 14.3.2026, not the due date 28.3.2026.

cases.title: Two documents in two languages give two records in order
cases.rubric: Two records, the Finnish invoice first. The English invoice's '2 April 2026' becomes 2026-04-02 and '1,250.00' becomes 1250. No value of one document appears in the other's record.

cases.title: Line items from the invoice text into the nested schema
cases.rubric: Exactly three line items in the invoice's order with their own quantities and prices. The net total, VAT and total rows are not line items.

cases.title: Vision extraction from the PDF invoice
cases.rubric: Same values as the text case: total including VAT 551,57 and the invoice date 14.3.2026, read from the page image.

cases.title: Vision extraction from a scanned (PNG) invoice
cases.rubric: Same values as the PDF case, from an image with no text layer.

cases.title: Vision extraction of line items from the PDF
cases.rubric: Three line items read from the page, same as the text case.
